Braking distance grows with the square of entering speed. A car entering a corner faster must brake earlier or harder, or both. 2. The brake channel marks when the driver applies the brake, not how much pressure is applied. A later brake onset is not automatically better: it may be enabled by higher grip, a different line, a tow, or a different entry speed.
